doc.title: Zutty Singleton and Marge Singleton Interview, 1969-02-08

chapter: Jelly Roll Morton in Chicago and early sightings
title: New Orleans piano players who made the rounds of the houses
summary: Asked if he spoke to Jelly Roll, Zutty says he only saw him; a handful of piano players made the rounds of the houses.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Did you get a chance to speak to Jelly Roll?

No, no, I didn't get a chance. I just saw him, and several times later, go around 25, this bar, and, uh, I don't see, Louis Wade, piano, and, uh, and, uh, and, uh, the big, and, uh, different times. Sisters of old P-Rong and P-Rong houses,
they had about five or six
piano players that made those rounds. That's all they would do.
Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Excuse me. Mm-hm.
